description: Source code for AppDelegate.m, implementing application delegate, web view configuration, and delegate methods for a macOS application using WebKit, with custom handling for headless browsing and browser contexts.

classes.name: NSApplication (PlaywrightApplicationExtensions)
classes.description: Category adding a method to get the app delegate.

classes.name: NSApplication (TouchBar)
classes.description: Category adding properties related to Touch Bar customization.

classes.name: WebViewDialog
classes.description: Custom dialog class for handling JavaScript dialogs in WKWebView.

classes.name: BrowserAppDelegate
classes.description: Main application delegate managing window creation, web view configurations, and delegate methods for a WebKit-based macOS app.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the app delegate, processes command-line arguments, and sets up headless mode and browser contexts.

methods.name: awakeFromNib
methods.description: Configures Touch Bar customization after nib loading.

methods.name: proxyConfiguration:WithBypassList:
methods.description: Creates a proxy configuration dictionary based on server URL and bypass list.

methods.name: persistentDataStore
methods.description: Returns a singleton WKWebsiteDataStore configured with local storage directories and proxy settings.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Creates and returns a default WKWebViewConfiguration with preferences and process pool settings.

methods.name: applicationDidFinishLaunching:
methods.description: Sets up initial window and web view after app launch, with a delay to create the first page.

methods.name: _updateNewWindowKeyEquivalents
methods.description: Sets keyboard shortcuts for new window menu items.

methods.name: sessionConfiguration:
methods.description: Provides a WKWebViewConfiguration for a given session ID, based on browser context.

methods.name: createNewPage:
methods.description: Creates a new WKWebView for a session ID, defaulting to about:blank.

methods.name: createNewPage:withURL:
methods.description: Creates a new WKWebView with specified URL for a session ID.

methods.name: createHeadfulPage:withURL:
methods.description: Creates a visible WKWebView inside a window for browsing.

methods.name: createHeadlessPage:withURL:
methods.description: Creates an offscreen WKWebView for headless browsing.

methods.name: createBrowserContext:WithBypassList:
methods.description: Creates a new browser context with specific proxy settings.

methods.name: deleteBrowserContext:
methods.description: Removes a browser context by session ID.

methods.name: quit
methods.description: Terminates the application.

methods.name: webViewDidClose:
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a web view is closed.

methods.name: _webView:getWindowFrameWithCompletionHandler:
methods.description: Retrieves the window frame of a web view.

methods.name: webView:runJavaScriptAlertPanelWithMessage:initiatedByFrame:completionHandler:
methods.description: Displays a JavaScript alert dialog.

methods.name: webView:runJavaScriptConfirmPanelWithMessage:initiatedByFrame:completionHandler:
methods.description: Displays a JavaScript confirm dialog.

methods.name: webView:runJavaScriptTextInputPanelWithPrompt:defaultText:initiatedByFrame:completionHandler:
methods.description: Displays a JavaScript prompt dialog.

methods.name: _webView:runBeforeUnloadConfirmPanelWithMessage:initiatedByFrame:completionHandler:
methods.description: Displays a before-unload confirmation dialog.

methods.name: webView:handleJavaScriptDialog:value:
methods.description: Handles JavaScript dialog responses.

methods.name: webView:createWebViewWithConfiguration:forNavigationAction:windowFeatures:
methods.description: Creates a new web view for a navigation action, e.g., target=_blank.

methods.name: webView:decidePolicyForNavigationAction:decisionHandler:
methods.description: Decides whether to allow or block navigation actions.

methods.name: webView:decidePolicyForNavigationResponse:decisionHandler:
methods.description: Decides whether to allow or download content based on response headers.

methods.name: webView:navigationAction:didBecomeDownload:
methods.description: Assigns delegate to a download when navigation indicates a download.

methods.name: webView:navigationResponse:didBecomeDownload:
methods.description: Assigns delegate to a download when response indicates a download.

methods.name: _webView:requestStorageAccessPanelForDomain:underCurrentDomain:completionHandler:
methods.description: Automatically grants storage access requests.

methods.name: download:decideDestinationUsingResponse:suggestedFilename:completionHandler:
methods.description: Handles download destination decision, currently not specifying a destination.
